name: com.almyty/mcp-server
title: almyty
description: Use your almyty tools, skills and agents from any MCP client.

packageArguments.description: Serve one gateway, as orgSlug/gatewaySlug. Leave it out to serve every gateway the token can see.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An almyty API key or login token. Without it the server reads ~/.almyty/credentials.json, written by `almyty login`.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_URL
environmentVariables.description: The almyty API to connect to. Set it for a self-hosted install.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_GATEWAY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Serve one gateway, as orgSlug/gatewaySlug. Same as the positional argument.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: skill-first registers two tools and serves skills as prompts; full registers every gateway tool on its own.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_MCP_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: How the server talks to almyty: auto tries MCP 2026-07-28 first and falls back to the earlier protocol.

environmentVariables.name: ALMYTY_DISCOVERY_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long the client's first message waits for the gateway's tool list, in milliseconds (0 to 60000).
